facts.fact: 坦白后的重新凝视：beer pong 前他先收走所有人的杯子——他不是经历的产物，他选择了善良。
facts.anchor: Oliver is not a product of his experiences. He chose to be like this.

facts.fact: 啤酒乒乓球邀约话术：他陪过她的碰碰车梦——现在该轮到她支持他的了。
facts.anchor: Come on, Eden. I supported you and your dodge ‘em car dreams. Support mine.

facts.fact: Jake 摊牌实况：报出 Kiara Mariano 全名时，爸妈的反应是——她已经在车道上了。
facts.anchor: And I said Kiara Mariano. And they said the Mariano who made Grandpa sell all the land? And I said yes that Mariano….she’s in the driveway.

facts.fact: 剧情反转：爸妈竟然爱 Kiara，还要求「cutesy family Sunday roast」——顺带追问「You're still together, right?」
Mum 想接电话——还要 Oliver 的：她想念那个男孩。
交易焦虑：上几次辅导课她没转钱——付钱=承认交易关系，不付=占他便宜，两头都不是。
facts.anchor: I haven’t transferred him for the last couple of sessions

facts.fact: Maddison 炸弹：Honours 奖学金申请上周五已截止——她把日期记成了下周五。
facts.anchor: It was due last Friday, and I haven’t received it yet.

facts.fact: Maddison 的救援承诺：去跟 board 说情——「会没事的，我们能解决」。
恐惧具象：没奖学金就养不起城里生活——回农场、被人闲话「自以为比谁都强」。
facts.anchor: I’d have to go back home to the farm.

facts.fact: 演讲现场：迟到的 Oliver 一进门，她从指尖到脚底结冰——全章温度计反向。
facts.anchor: From the tips of my fingers to the bottom of my feet, ice settles throughout my body.

facts.fact: 分手句：他背身说出「你还欠我上次辅导的四十块钱」——然后走了，她的心跟着走了。
facts.anchor: You owe me forty bucks from the last tutoring session.
